applicant_utility.summary: Confirm your supervisor before you apply, not after: confirmation of supervision is compulsory for the Faculties of Arts, Medicine and Health Sciences, and Science and Engineering, and only desirable for Business. Your prior degree must be finished - anyone in their final semester is excluded unless they are a Macquarie applicant or applying through the Business School. Applying for the iRTP automatically puts you in the iMQRES pool in the same round, so one application covers two funding routes and there is no separate form to find.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants with a completed degree, a confirmed Macquarie supervisor and a project that maps onto Macquarie's Research Strategy 2035.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure written confirmation of supervision before lodging if you are applying through FOA, FMHHS or FSE
Check you have formally completed your degree - final-semester applicants are excluded except Macquarie and MQBS applicants
Assemble full documentation of achievements, including any research masters thesis abstract, examiner reports and percentage research component
Select 'International Research Scholarship' as the scholarship type in the application form
If already enrolled in a Session 2 2026 program or holding a PhD letter of offer from the last six months, use the Scholarship Only application instead
common_rejection_risks: Submitting an incomplete application - Macquarie states these are withdrawn and cannot be held over to a future round
Receiving another equivalent or major award, full scholarship or salary for the proposed program
Being enrolled in a progressing Macquarie cohort such as Graduate Diploma of Research to MRes or MRes to PhD
Having already completed a research degree at the same or higher level in the same program of study
Providing false or misleading information, which lets the University reassess your entitlement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Sydney living costs beyond the $40,900 stipend, visa costs, and any local transport beyond the OPAL card concession.
document_audit: Overseas qualifications are assessed against the Australian Qualifications Framework using Australian Government guidelines, so allow time for that assessment
Refereed publications and conference presentations are specifically listed as relevant evidence - list them explicitly rather than burying them in a CV
If you are relying on a research masters, you will be asked for the thesis abstract, examiner reports, length, examination process and the percentage research component
alerts: The number of international places funded through the RTP varies from year to year, so an offer is not guaranteed even at high rank
If you do not receive an outcome notification by 15 November 2026, Macquarie tells you to consider the application unsuccessful
Stipend top-ups from industry or other sources are capped at 100% of the stipend value
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Lodge the graduate research application with 'International Research Scholarship' selected, Macquarie ranks and assesses applicants including the research environment, then notifies outcomes.

applicant_utility.summary: One PUCA1029 application puts you in front of several awards at once, including this Scientia scholarship, the UNSW Law & Justice International Award and the Business School international scholarships - so never submit only the one you have heard of. The application is almost entirely evidence-driven: an unanswered question or an unevidenced claim is simply not assessed, so budget your time for uploads rather than prose. Because you must already hold an offer by the deadline, sequence your admission application first and treat the scholarship form as the second half of the same submission.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants holding an unconditional UNSW coursework offer for Term 1 2027 who can document academic merit plus leadership and extracurricular evidence.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure your UNSW offer for Term 1 2027 before 30 October 2026, since the scholarship application cannot proceed without it
Register in the Scholarship Application Online portal well before the deadline and confirm the account works
Collect evidence for each of the four criteria separately - academic merit, leadership, extracurricular activities, and reasons for choosing UNSW
If you are on a UEEC conditional English package offer, confirm your UNSW Institute of Languages enrolment is in place
Check that your chosen program is on campus and not UNSW Online or UNSW Canberra
common_rejection_risks: Leaving questions blank or making claims without supporting documentation, which are not assessed
Submitting supporting documents after the deadline - UNSW states late applications and late documents are not accepted
Holding a conditional offer whose outstanding conditions include English language or Genuine Student requirements
Assuming an offer will arrive after the deadline if you are a UAC International applicant with pending Year 12 results
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: All living costs, accommodation and health cover, plus any tuition above the $20,000 per annum Offer 2 level if you do not receive the full-fee Offer 1.
document_audit: Each criterion needs its own supporting evidence, so a single undifferentiated CV is not enough
The University publishes a Scholarship Application Supporting Documents guide listing acceptable examples per criterion - read it before uploading
Separate automatic awards on the same page, such as Australia's Global University Award and the UNSW College Award, require no application, so do not waste effort applying for those
alerts: Rounds are term-based and repeat each intake, so a missed Term 1 2027 deadline means waiting for the next term's window rather than losing the chance permanently
UNSW reserves the right not to award a scholarship where there is no applicant of sufficient merit
A separate International Student Award gives a 20% tuition contribution for 2027 starters and is considered with your admission application, not the PUCA1029 form
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the single PUCA1029 application in the Scholarship Application Online portal with all evidence attached; UNSW then assesses the pooled applicants against the published criteria.
